description: OpenPost is a workspace for creating, adapting, scheduling, publishing, and tracking social content across supported social networks. It is available as a hosted service and as open-source software you can self-host.
summary: OpenPost exposes one authenticated HTTP API at `https://app.openpo.st/api/v1`, an OAuth/API-token-protected MCP server at `https://app.openpo.st/mcp`, and an `openpost` CLI that talks to the same service.
